observations: Photo 0 shows a single black tyre with a deep tread pattern, resting on a concrete surface.
Photo 1 shows a stack of four tyres with a wavy, diamond-shaped tread pattern, likely winter or all-season tyres.
Photo 2 shows a stack of alloy wheels; the top wheel has a black and silver five-spoke design with a Mercedes-Benz logo.
A watermark 'D-KACHI ENTERPRISE' is visible on all three photos.

claims.evidence: The grade of a tyre cannot be determined from a photo of its tread.
The tread pattern in photo 0 is not a standard 'tokumbo' pattern; it appears to be a standard all-season or winter tyre.
The brand name is not visible on the sidewall in any photo.

risks.risk: Tyres may be old stock with degraded rubber.
risks.proof: A photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: Tyres may be used or have tread depth below legal limits.
risks.proof: A photo of the tread depth with a depth gauge.

risks.risk: The wheels may be used or have surface damage.
risks.proof: Photos of the wheel surfaces and hub nuts.

risks.risk: The seller may be a scammer.
risks.proof: A video showing the tyres and wheels being held up for inspection.

proof_requests: Photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall of the tyres.
Photo of the tread depth with a depth gauge.
Photos of the wheel surfaces and hub nuts.
Video showing the tyres and wheels being held up.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
